title: Clarify the boundary between DPI-H and point-of-service applications
requirements:
- Add a short 'what is and is not a DPI-H component' summary at the start of 3.5 with examples
- Apply DPI-H classification to capabilities or logical components rather than whole products
- Treat CHW-facing applications as a distinct concern, as a component or a defined interface layer
- Revise the definition so applications that write to shared infrastructure carry conformance and provenance obligations
- Justify, not only state, the exclusion of point-of-care clinical systems
- Add a boundary contract stating what data-producing and consuming systems must provide
